Helpers for optional HTTP range-based windowing flows.Parses an items Range header value into an ItemRangeSpec, reporting malformed ranges in the error field.Returns true if a mode or window parameter value enables range-based windowing.Builds a Content-Range header value for a satisfied partial range.Builds a Content-Range header value for an unsatisfied range with the not-satisfiable spec.Resolves an items range request into a WindowedItemsDecision covering satisfied, malformed, and unsatisfied outcomes.
